say:1:1033128001:1.text: Mr. Korin is a good man! It's not just me and Johann either; he's been kind to everyone here!
say:1:1033128001:1.source_cn: 科林先生可是位大好人！不仅是我和约伯安，这里的人都受过...
say:1:1033128001:1.male: Mr. Korin is a good man! It's not just me and Johann either; he's been kind to everyone here!
say:1:1033128001:1.female: Mr. Korin is a good man! It's not just me and Johann either; he's been kind to everyone here!

say:2:1033128002:1.text: If it wasn't for him, I fear we wouldn't have been able to build this camp, let alone survive this long.
say:2:1033128002:1.source_cn: 要是没有他，恐怕我们建不起这座营地，更活不到现在。
say:2:1033128002:1.male: If it wasn't for him, I fear we wouldn't have been able to build this camp, let alone survive this long.
say:2:1033128002:1.female: If it wasn't for him, I fear we wouldn't have been able to build this camp, let alone survive this long.

say:3:1033128003:1.text: He also agreed to help us persuade the Wilders and think of a way to get around the exclusion edict.
say:3:1033128003:1.source_cn: 而且他还答应要帮我们说服绿裔成员，想办法解除封锁令。
say:3:1033128003:1.male: He also agreed to help us persuade the Wilders and think of a way to get around the exclusion edict.
say:3:1033128003:1.female: He also agreed to help us persuade the Wilders and think of a way to get around the exclusion edict.

say:4:1033128004:1.text: Such kindness... We really don't know how to repay him.
say:4:1033128004:1.source_cn: 这么大的恩情……我们真不知道该怎么回报他。
say:4:1033128004:1.male: Such kindness... We really don't know how to repay him.
say:4:1033128004:1.female: Such kindness... We really don't know how to repay him.
